home.browser_title: koztechie — Eugene Kozlovsky, developer and systems architect
home.lead: This is my personal website. It's a collection of my projects, code, and writing. I share what I'm working on in two languages, with no strict publishing schedule.
home.cta_note: Replies usually take a few days; delays may happen.

principles.title: Focus on the essence
principles.text: I share things I've actually verified in practice and don't pretend to be an expert in everything. No clickbait or made-up stories.

principles.title: A working space
principles.text: I openly document my technical decisions, experiments, and mistakes. However, my personal life stays off the site.

principles.title: Contact by email
principles.text: You won't find comment sections, live chats, or annoying pop-ups here. If you have a question or proposal, just shoot me an email.

principles.title: No deadlines
principles.text: I only update the site when I actually have something to share. Long gaps between posts are completely normal.
